policy.pairConvention: Each candidate contains concrete positive data and a concrete targeted mutation. Expected PASS/FAIL applies only to the named logical predicate, never transaction acceptance.
policy.mutationConvention: Replace the named field with mutation.value; unchanged fields and explicit context remain unchanged. Values under a dotted path are logical fields, not serialization instructions.
policy.representation: Structured component strings, numeric values and byte arrays are logical fragments. No table header, ambiguous aggregate, binary transport or full request is serialized.

policy.coverageMeaning: Table classifications enumerate scoped candidates and unresolved gaps, not certified layout completeness. Container and component predicates are not interchangeable.
policy.fullMessageGap: This bounded batch supplies logical fragments only. Financial request scaffolding, lifecycle fixtures and unresolved layout decisions must be separately authorized and reviewed before full-message construction.
